body:
Thanks for the feedback. I'll see what I can do. Some of the things you ask are already possible.. it's true though that the documentation is not that extensive (to say the least :-)
One remark though: ART is not RT, and doesn't try to stay compatible with it. It was forked about 6.5 years ago, so "it doesn't work like RT" is not an argument I'm particularly sensitive about.

Best
